```{r message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scater)
library(scran)
library(DelayedArray)

pacman::p_load(torch, luz)

source("src/lib_OR_loss.R")
source("src/lib_OR_torch_model.R")
source("src/read_data.R")

set.seed(12)
```

# Importing Alzheimer data

```{r}

e <- readRDS("data/sce.EC.scAlign.assigned.rds")
s <- readRDS("data/sce.SFG.scAlign.assigned.rds")

sce_alz <- cbind(e,s)
```

```{r}
bp <-BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 10)
```


```{r}
sce_alz <- runUMAP(sce_alz, name = "UMAP_merged", n_threads=10)
```


```{r}
plotReducedDim(sce_alz, dimred = "UMAP_merged",colour_by="BrainRegion")
```


```{r}
sce_alz$PatientID <- as.integer(sce_alz$PatientID)

colData(sce_alz) <- DataFrame(dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::as_tibble(colData(sce_alz)), metaD))
sce_alz$PatientID <- as.factor(sce_alz$PatientID)

sce_alz$age <- as.factor(sce_alz$age)
```



## Train - test splitting

```{r}
sce_alz <- sce_alz[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_alz)[2]), size = dim(sce_alz)[2]*0.5)]

train <- sce_alz[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_alz)[2]), size = dim(sce_alz)[2]*.7)]
test <- sce_alz[, !colnames(sce_alz) %in% colnames(train)]

```

```{r}
saveRDS(train, "data/train_50p.rds")
saveRDS(test, "data/test_50p.rds")
```


```{r}
plotReducedDim(train, dimred = "UMAP_merged",colour_by="BraakStage")
```

```{r}
plotReducedDim(test, dimred = "UMAP_merged",colour_by="BraakStage")
```


```{r}
table(train$BrainRegion) ; table(train$BraakStage)
table(test$BrainRegion) ; table(test$BraakStage)
table(train$BraakStage,train$clusterCellType)
```

# Torch import

## Alzheimer

```{r}
train <- readRDS("data/train_50p.rds")
test <- readRDS("data/test_50p.rds")
```



```{r}
metaD <- data.frame(list(PatientID=c(seq(1:10)),
                         age=c(50,60,71,72, 77, 87, 91, 72, 82, 82),
                         PTI=c(13, 12, 12, 15, 4.9, 30, 50, 6.9, 6.7, 9)))
```


```{r}
train$PatientID <- as.integer(train$PatientID)
test$PatientID <- as.integer(test$PatientID)

colData(train) <- DataFrame(dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::as_tibble(colData(train)), metaD))
colData(test) <- DataFrame(dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::as_tibble(colData(test)), metaD))

train$PatientID <- as.factor(train$PatientID)
test$PatientID <- as.factor(test$PatientID)

train$age <- as.factor(train$age)
test$age <- as.factor(test$age)
```


```{r}
train_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(train)), y=as.integer(train$age))

test_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(test)), y=as.integer(test$age))
```



## Schizophrenia

```{r}
scz <- read_scz()
scz_sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays=list(counts=assay(scz)))
colData(scz_sce) <- colData(scz)
scz_sce$donor.Age <- as.factor(scz_sce$donor.Age)

scz_sce <- logNormCounts(scz_sce, BPPARAM=bp)
scz_sce <- scz_sce[((counts(scz_sce)>0) |> rowMeans()) > 0.01]

```



```{r splitting_male_female}
male_scz <- scz_sce[,scz_sce$donor.Gender=="M"]
female_scz <- scz_sce[, scz_sce$donor.Gender=="F"]
```



```{r sampling_male_female}
train_male <- male_scz[, sample(dim(male_scz)[2], size = dim(male_scz)[2]*0.7)]
test_male <- male_scz[, !colnames(male_scz) %in% colnames(train_male)]

train_female <- female_scz[, sample(dim(female_scz)[2], size = dim(female_scz)[2]*0.7)]
test_female <- female_scz[, !colnames(female_scz) %in% colnames(train_female)]
```


```{r preparing_torch_Dataset}

train_male_ds <- delayed_ds(t(logcounts(train_male)), as.integer(train_male$donor.Age))
test_male_ds <- delayed_ds(t(logcounts(test_male)), as.integer(test_male$donor.Age))

train_female_ds <- delayed_ds(t(logcounts(train_female)), as.integer(train_female$donor.Age))
test_female_ds <- delayed_ds(t(logcounts(test_female)), as.integer(test_female$donor.Age))

```


```{r test_data_F&M}

test_scz <- cbind(test_male, test_female)
test_scz_ds <- delayed_ds(t(logcounts(test_scz)), as.integer(test_scz$donor.Age))
```



## Cost matrix


```{r}
scaling_factor <- function(ranks){
  m_2 <- length(ranks)**2
  #browser()
  m_sum <- sum(table(ranks)**2)
  (m_2-m_sum)*0.5
}

sf <- scaling_factor(train_ds$y)
```



```{r}
C_stage <- torch_tensor(matrix(c(0,2,6, 2,0,4, 6,4,0), nrow = 3, ncol = 3,
       dimnames = list(c("1", "2", "3"),
                       c("1", "2", "3"))), dtype = torch_float(), device = "cpu")

```


```{r cost_age_alzheimer}

cost_age <- dist(levels(train_filtered$age), diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE)|> 
  as.matrix() |> 
  torch_tensor(dtype = torch_float(), device="cuda")

```


```{r cost_age_schizophrenia}

cost_age <- dist(as.numeric(levels(scz_sce$donor.Age)), diag = TRUE,upper = TRUE) |>
  as.matrix() |>
  torch_tensor(dtype = torch_float(), device="cpu")

```


# Model training


```{r braak_stage_model}
fitted_stage <- ordinal_classifier |>
  setup(loss = nn_ordinal_regression_loss(c=c),
        optimizer = optim_adam) |>
  set_hparams(feature_names=rownames(train),
              class_names=train_ds$y) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=.7) |>
  fit(train_ds,
      epochs=100L,
      dataloader_options=list(batch_size=100L),
      valid_data=test_ds, verbose=TRUE,
      #, accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE)
      # ,
      callbacks=list(luz_callback_early_stopping(monitor="valid_loss", mode = "min", patience = 5))
      )
```


```{r age_model}
fitted_age <- ordinal_classifier |>
  setup(loss = nn_ordinal_regression_loss(C = cost_age),
        optimizer = optim_adam) |>
  set_hparams(feature_names=rownames(train_male),
              class_names=train_male_ds$y) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=.1, lr=1e-3) |>
  fit(train_male_ds,
      epochs=100L,
      dataloader_options=list(batch_size=1000L),
      valid_data=test_male_ds, verbose=TRUE,
      # accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE),
      #,
      callbacks=list(luz_callback_early_stopping(monitor="valid_loss", mode = "min", patience = 5),
                     luz_callback(on_fit_begin=function(){luz_load_model_weights(ctx,"models/model_OR_age_scz_weights.luz")})())
      )

model_join <- nn_join |>

        optimizer = optim_adam) |>
  set_hparams(ordinal_classifier(feature_names=rownames(train_male),class_names=levels(train_female$donor.Age))) |>

  fit(data=my_ds,
      epochs=1L,

      )
```

## Performance study


```{r}
y_hat <- predict(fitted_age, test_scz_ds)
test_scz$pred_age <- as_array(y_hat$to(device="cpu"))
boxplot(as_array(y_hat$to(device="cpu")) ~ test_scz$donor.Age)
```


```{r}
ggcells(test_scz, aes(x=pred_age, y=paste(donor.Age,donor_id), fill=donor.Diagnosis)) + geom_boxplot()+ facet_wrap(~donor.Gender)
```


```{r}
ggcells(test_scz, aes(x=donor.Age, y=pred_age)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_summary(aes(group=donor.Gender, color=donor.Gender), geom = "line")
```

# Feature Attribution

## Age model

```{r}
fitted_age <- luz_load("models/model_OR_age_wo_sf_Arch4.luz")
magnitudes <- torch_abs(fitted_age$model$layers[[2]]$parameters$weight)

norm_magnitudes <- torch_div(magnitudes, magnitudes$sum(2, keepdim = TRUE)) |> 
  torch_sum(dim = 1)

norm_magnitudes <- as_array(norm_magnitudes$to(device = "cpu"))

plot(sort(norm_magnitudes))

#feature_importance <- order(as_array(norm_magnitudes$to(device = "cpu")), decreasing = TRUE)
```


```{r}
rowData(train)$norm_magnitude <- norm_magnitudes
```

> length(norm_magnitudes[norm_magnitudes>0.35])
> length(norm_magnitudes[norm_magnitudes<1e-6])


```{r}
train_filtered <- train[rowData(train)$norm_magnitude>0.3,]
test_filtered <- test[rownames(test) %in% rownames(train_filtered),]
```

```{r}

train_ds_filtered <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(train_filtered)), y=as.integer(train_filtered$age))
test_ds_filtered <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(test_filtered)), y=as.integer(test_filtered$age))

```


```{r}
test_filtered$pred<-as_array(y_hat$to(device="cpu"))
```


```{r}
ggcells(test_filtered, aes(x=pred, y=paste(age, PatientID))) + geom_boxplot()
```
